capabilities.name: Mobile-initiated encrypted desktop context refresh
capabilities.summary: Refresh an explicitly selected saved profile and frozen owner-date, source and detail scope on an authenticated paired desktop, without export files or file quota, and recover a durable request-bound status after disconnect or restart.

apple.target: Qualify the Apple Sync context-automation v1 source and both iOS App Intents on exact-head hosted Xcode CI and physical iPhone/Mac automation, old-peer, locked, restart and accessibility gates before release. Initial adapter requires authenticated Manual IP v2 and Apple Health source scope.

android.target: Add explicit refresh/status automation actions to AutomationReceiver with saved-profile and owner-date Health Connect scope, durable mobile receipts and an authenticated capability-negotiated encrypted desktop-context receiver. Existing direct raw acquisition and desktop CLI export are not this mobile-initiated no-file outcome.
